create_package_mangler: create a PackageMangler instance to mangle and demangle module names with a unique prefix
mangle_module_name: mangle a module name using PackageMangler.mangle to prepend a unique package prefix
demangle_module_name: demangle a mangled module name using PackageMangler.demangle to extract the original name
test_is_mangled: test whether a module name matches the torch_package mangling pattern using is_mangled
get_mangle_prefix: get the mangling prefix from a mangled module name using get_mangle_prefix
